label: The Claude ask-surface Stop hook reads stdin with a bare blocking readFileSync(0) on its live entry path and has no deadline, unlike the codex and devin variants; it is registered in .claude/settings.json, so a host that never closes stdin holds it until the host timeout, the catch returns empty, JSON.parse throws and the turn ends with exitCode 0 having never run the guard (silent fail-open).

v4.0.2.0 claims no check knows a hermes runtime and AGENTS.md no longer describes Hermes personas, but the doctor AGENTS.md payload manifest still contains ".hermes/agents/", "Hermes is the exception", HERMES_AGENT_PERSONA and "The cli-hermes packet owns the mechanics", so the breaking change is incomplete exactly where it propagates furthest into vendored repos.

The stdin deadline is not one number: shared-stdin.ts exports 3000ms per v4.0.0.8, but claude/user-prompt-submit.ts sets its own STDIN_DEADLINE_MS of 500ms plus MAX_STDIN_BYTES and CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS bounds, so the release note describes one helper rather than hook stdin generally and a reviewer testing the 3s rule there would misread a 500ms exit as a regression.

One deadline contract has three reader implementations (hook-adapter-shared.cjs, hook-adapter-shared.mjs, shared-stdin.ts) and two parallel hook-stdin-deadline test suites; neither reader copy is removable because CommonJS cannot synchronously require ESM on every supported Node, so only the duplicated test suite is genuinely redundant, and f-iter006-001 is the direct cost since a caller reached for a fourth approach.

The Gate-1 trigger index still carries paths into the removed cli-hermes-creation packet (071) although v4.0.2.0 says a request naming Hermes routes nowhere; recorded as drift rather than contradiction because the hits are document paths in a files array rather than trigger patterns, but the next reader cannot tell whether the missing scoped trigger was deliberate.

Every hook entry point that reads stdin must settle on whichever comes first: end of input or its deadline. A blocking read with no deadline violates it, because the hook then settles on the host timeout and fails open without running.

A removal release note that asserts "no file knows X anymore" is a claim about every generated artifact including the doctor payload that regenerates AGENTS.md in downstream repos, not only about the current checkout.

v4.0.0.16 git-call time limit holds where searched: the only unflagged git invocation in the hook roots is capture-core.mjs execFileSync git rev-parse with timeout 5000 and GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE stripped; no execSync/spawnSync/execFileSync git match in any other hook root. The raw-stdin bypass has no raw-git counterpart.

Pi cache-optimizer Hermes hits (isHermesLikeModel, Nous/Hermes/OpenHermes, "Hermes cache" label) are the model family served by an API, a different namespace from the removed cli-hermes CLI, and are correctly retained, not residue; likewise two test fixtures whose prompt text merely reads "Commit orca & sync Hermes".
